__1 Mildness, affability, softness. 
__2 Skilfulness (कौशल्य); प्रहस्य मन्दं पैशल्यादभ्यभाषत बीर्यवान् [[

a. 
(-ची f.) [पिशाचेन निर्वृत्तः अण्] Demoniacal, infernal. 
-चः 
__1 The eighth or lowest of the eight forms [Page1048-2] of marriage in Hindu law, in which a lover ravishes a maiden without her consent when she is sleeping, or intoxicated, or deranged in intellect; सुप्तां मत्तां प्रमत्तां वा रहो यत्रोपगच्छति । स पापिष्ठो विवाहानां पैशाचश्चाष्टमोऽ धमः [[

.]] 
__2 A kind of demon or पिशाच. 
-ची 
__1 A present made at a religious ceremony. 
__2 Night. 
__3 A sort of gibberish spoken on the stage by demons. 
__4 One of the forms of Prākṛta.

पैशुनम्,
 
-न्यम् [पिशुनस्य भावः अण् ष्यञ् वा] 
__1 Backbiting, slandering, tale-bearing, calumny; पैशुन्यं साहसं … … क्रोधजोऽपि गणोऽष्टकः [[

a. 
(-ष्टी f.) [पिष्टस्येदम् अण्] Made of flour or meal.

a. 
(-की f.) Made of flour or meal. 
-कम् 
__1 A number of cakes. 
__2 A spirituous liquor distilled from meal.
A spirituous liquor distilled from meal; cf. गौडी; गौडी पैष्टी च माध्वी च विज्ञेया त्रिविधा सुरा [[
